pharmacology.text: Desmetramadol (INN), also known as O-desmethyltramadol (O-DSMT), is an opioid analgesic and the main active metabolite of tramadol. Because desmetramadol itself does not need to be metabolized to induce an analgesic effect, it can be used in individuals with CYP2D6 inactivating mutations.

uses.text: Because desmetramadol itself does not need to be metabolized to induce an analgesic effect, it can be used in individuals with CYP2D6 inactivating mutations. Desmetramadol is commonly encountered as a designer drug online in powder form or as an ingredient in pressed pills due to being unscheduled in many jurisdictions.
uses.recreational: A herbal remedy called Krypton was found to contain kratom leaf powder and desmetramadol. Krypton was reportedly linked to at least 9 accidental opioid overdose deaths in Sweden during 2010–2011.

sideEffects.en: It causes the usual opioid effects of drowsiness, nausea and constipation, and can slow breathing. Like tramadol it is linked to seizures, and because tramadol also acts on serotonin there is a risk of serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 它會造成鴉片類常見的嗜睡、噁心與便祕，並可能抑制呼吸。與曲馬多一樣，它與癲癇發作有關；由於曲馬多也作用於血清素，因此有血清素症候群的風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会造成鸦片类常见的嗜睡、恶心与便秘，并可能抑制呼吸。与曲马多一样，它与癫痫发作有关；由于曲马多也作用于血清素，因此有血清素症候群的风险。

fact.en: Tramadol relies on the liver turning it into this metabolite for most of its pain relief, and people whose enzymes work slowly get far less effect from tramadol.
fact.zh: 曲馬多的止痛效果大多依賴肝臟把它轉變成這個代謝物，因此酵素作用較慢的人，從曲馬多得到的效果會少得多。
fact.zhHans: 曲马多的止痛效果大多依赖肝脏把它转变成这个代谢物，因此酵素作用较慢的人，从曲马多得到的效果会少得多。
